welcome.description: I'm your AI study assistant for GCE O-Level and A-Level exams. Ask me questions, practice with past papers, or sit a mock exam - all right here on WhatsApp.

onboarding.selectLevel: Which level are you preparing for?
onboarding.selectSubjectsPrompt:
Great! Which subjects are you taking? Just tell me in your own words - e.g. "Biology, Chemistry, and Add Maths".

Available subjects: {{subjectList}}
onboarding.noSubjectsUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't catch any subjects in that. Could you tell me which ones you're taking?
onboarding.subjectsSaved: Awesome, you're all set with {{subjects}}! 🎉 If you ever want to change your subjects, just tell me.

menu.title: Main Menu - what would you like to do?

settings.resetting: Let's update your level and subjects.

qa.selectSubject: Which subject would you like to ask about?
qa.noSubjectsRegistered: You haven't picked any subjects yet. Send /settings to choose your level and subjects first.
qa.askAnything: Great! Ask me anything about {{subject}}. Type your question 👇
qa.followUpPrompt: What would you like to do next?
qa.askAnotherPrompt: 👇 Go ahead, type your next question.
qa.noActiveQuestion: Ask a question first, then I can give you a hint!
qa.quotaExceeded: You've used all 10 free questions today 📚 Upgrade to Basic (1,500 FCFA/month) for unlimited questions! Send /subscribe to upgrade.

practice.selectSubject: Which subject would you like to practice?
practice.noSubjectsRegistered: You haven't picked any subjects yet. Send /settings to choose your level and subjects first.
practice.noTopicsAvailable: No past questions are available for {{subject}} yet. Try a different subject.
practice.noMoreQuestions: No more questions match your filters right now. Try /practice again with different filters, or check back after more content is added.
practice.mcqWrong: ❌ Not quite. The correct answer is {{correctLetter}}. {{explanation}}
practice.mcqGradingUnavailable: I couldn't automatically grade this question, but I've recorded your answer.
practice.essayGradingUnavailable: I couldn't find a marking scheme for this question, but I've recorded your answer.
practice.postAnswerPrompt: What would you like to do next?

mock.premiumRequired: ⏱️ Mock exams are a Premium feature. Upgrade for 3,000 FCFA/month to simulate real exam conditions! Send /subscribe.
mock.noSubjectsRegistered: You haven't picked any subjects yet. Send /settings to choose your level and subjects first.
mock.selectSubject: Which subject would you like to sit a mock exam for?
mock.readyPrompt: You're about to start a timed {{subject}} mock exam. Duration: {{duration}} minutes. It cannot be paused once started. Ready?
mock.cancelled: No problem - your mock exam was cancelled.
mock.noContentAvailable: No past questions are available yet to build a {{subject}} mock exam. Try a different subject or check back once more content is added.
mock.reportNoTopicData: No topic data available for this exam.
mock.reportStudyTipFallback: Keep practicing past questions regularly - consistency matters more than cramming.
mock.reportUngraded: ✅ Your exam was submitted, but we couldn't grade it automatically this time. Contact support if this persists.
mock.reportUnavailable: We couldn't find your exam report. Contact support if this persists.

help.title: Available commands:
help.commandList:
/menu - Main menu
/settings - Change level & subjects
/ask - Ask a question
/hint - Get a hint for your current question
/practice - Practice past questions
/mock - Start a timed mock exam
/skip - Skip the current mock exam question
/submit - Submit your mock exam early
/progress - View your progress
/en - Switch to English
/fr - Switch to French
/help - Show this message

progress.title: 📚 *Your Progress*
progress.noActivity: You haven't answered any questions yet! Try /ask, /practice, or /mock to get started.
progress.weeklyTipNoActivity: We haven't seen you this week - come back and answer a few questions to keep your streak alive!
progress.weeklyTipFallback: Keep practicing past questions regularly - consistency matters more than cramming.
progress.milestoneCelebration: 🎉 {{days}}-day streak! You're on fire! Here's 7 days of Premium on us 🎁

errors.unknownCommand: I didn't understand that. Send /menu to see options.
errors.tryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try again.

quota.exceeded: You've reached your free question limit for today.
quota.upgradePrompt: Upgrade to Premium for unlimited access!
